commits.message:
Add architecture docs and update CLAUDE.md (Closes #33)

New docs in cvbuilder/docs/:
- database-schema.md: ER diagram, Work vs CVItem models, section key registry
- data-flows.md: PDF generation, pub sync, DOI enrichment, curation, YAML flows
- component-architecture.md: system overview, backend layers, frontend patterns

Updated CLAUDE.md to reflect post-migration architecture:
- Complete project tree (all 10 routers, 8 services, 10 pages, 6 components)
- Split "adding a section" into CVItem and Work type checklists
- Fix misc sections, sort order, and ALL_SECTIONS references

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add DOI discovery for works without DOIs (#32, Stage 5)

Search Crossref by title + bibliographic metadata when a work has no DOI.
Accept if title similarity >= 0.95 standalone, or >= 0.80 with 2+
corroborating signals (year, first author, journal, volume, issue, pages).
Discovered works get full metadata diffs like DOI-bearing works.

Closes #32

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add citation preview and improve name comparison (#32, Stages 3-4)

- Add color-coded citation preview to Complete Fields review modal
  (green = accepted change, red = rejected conflict, plain = unchanged)
- Rewrite _is_fuller_name to compare name parts individually so
  multi-part given names like "K. E." vs "Kimberly E." are detected
- Add accent detection: "Martinez" → "Martínez" proposed as improvement
- Strip HTML tags from Crossref titles before comparison
- Add Unicode NFKC normalization to field comparison

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge middle_name into given_name and add Complete Fields UI (#32, Stage 2)

No publication database uses a separate middle_name field — Crossref, PubMed,
ORCID, and CSL all store it in the given/first name. The separate field caused
false positives in author diff comparison (Crossref "Sanjana V." looked fuller
than given_name="Sanjana" when middle_name="V" was already stored).

- Merge middle_name into given_name via migration, drop the column
- Update name_parser to produce combined given_name (no middle_name key)
- Update name_format to split given_name into first+middle for citation styles
- Fix _is_fuller_name to normalize dots on both sides (no false positives)
- Fix trailing-initials parser path that period-split full names ("T.o.m.a.s.")
- Add Complete Missing Fields frontend: button, review modal, accept/skip flow
- Remove middle_name from all models, schemas, routers, services, and frontend

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add complete-fields endpoint for Crossref metadata diff (#32, Stage 1)

Backend foundation for the "Complete Missing Fields" feature: schemas for
field/author diffs, lookup_doi_raw + compute_work_diffs service functions,
POST /complete-fields read-only endpoint, and exclude_unset fix on work update.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add prev/next navigation to edit modals and mass review for works

Add useItemNavigation hook with auto-save-then-navigate, keyboard
shortcuts (left/right arrow keys), and stale-closure-safe refs.
Add NavigableModal component with prev/next arrows and position
indicator. Integrate into both Sections and Publications edit
modals. Add mass review selection with checkboxes, "Review
Selected" walk-through mode, and Select All/Clear controls.
Update query cache after each navigation save so back-navigation
shows saved values.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add structured author names, citation styles, and author enrichment

Store given/family/middle/suffix on WorkAuthor and Profile with
auto-parsing from free-text names. Add citation style support
(APA, Vancouver, Chicago, Full) with per-template style picker
and full citation formatting via Jinja2 filters. Add single-work
and bulk author enrichment endpoints that populate structured
fields from CrossRef. Frontend gets expandable structured name
fields on author rows and profile, plus Save & Preview in the
template editor.

Closes #13

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add user password change and admin password reset

- Users can change their own password from the Profile page (requires
  current password verification)
- Admins can reset any user's password from the Users management page
- Both enforce minimum 6-character password length
- Frontend includes validation for password match and length
- 7 new backend tests covering success, auth, and validation cases

Closes #25

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Rename header alignment to identity block alignment and add heading alignment

- Rename "Header alignment" to "Identity block alignment" to clarify it
  controls the name/contact block, not section headings
- Add new "Heading alignment" style property for section headings
  (defaults to left)
- Remove preview buttons from editor dialogs since they can only show
  saved state, not in-progress edits (card-level previews remain)

Closes #29

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix preview buttons to open in new tab instead of broken inline iframe

Replace the non-functional split-pane iframe preview in the Template
composer and CV Instance editor with new-tab links, matching the
behavior of the preview buttons on the card views.

Closes #27

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Convert templates to global system templates with YAML library and import

- Move template definitions from hardcoded Python dicts to YAML files in
  template_library/ (14 institution templates)
- System templates use user_id=NULL, visible to all users without per-user
  seeding
- Add template copy, YAML export, and YAML import endpoints
- Frontend shows system vs user templates, with copy/export/import actions
- CV instances can now reference system templates
- Add is_system flag to template schema and TypeScript types

Closes #28

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add template metadata fields and 4 international university CV templates

Add author, author_contact, and guidance_url metadata columns to CVTemplate
with migration, schema, and frontend support. Metadata is displayed on
template cards and editable in the template composer.

Add 4 new validated international university templates:
- Imperial College CV (Arial, navy, per PFDC tip sheet)
- Oxford CV (serif, Oxford Blue, UPPERCASE headings, per Careers Service example)
- HKU CV (sans-serif, HKU Green, validated against faculty CV examples)
- Melbourne CV (12pt serif, 2cm margins, per promotions guidelines)

All use A4 page size. Section ordering validated against official guidance
documents and real faculty CVs where available.

Also seeds templates for all existing users on startup (not just user 1)
and adds guidance URLs to all existing seeded templates.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix YAML import crash on files with trailing document separator

yaml.safe_load() rejects files containing a trailing '---' (e.g., the
Einstein sample CV). Switch to safe_load_all() + next() so only the
first document is parsed and any trailing separators are ignored.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix custom sections to use correct heading CSS class

Changed cv-section-title to cv-section-heading in the custom section
renderer so custom sections inherit the template's heading styles
(font, color, decoration, transform).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add custom section definitions and cross-template import (Phases 2-3)

Phase 2: Custom user-defined sections
- New SectionDefinition model with user_id, section_key, label, layout,
  fields (JSON), and sort_field
- CRUD router at /api/section-definitions with auto-generated custom_* keys
- Generic renderer in base.html {% else %} block handles entry and list layouts
- _build_cv_data() queries custom section items dynamically
- cv_instances.py handles custom_* keys for curation
- SectionDefinitionEditor modal for creating/editing field schemas
- Sections.tsx dynamically generates tabs for custom sections
- Templates.tsx and CVInstances.tsx pass custom sections to picker

Phase 3: Cross-template section copying
- "Import from Template" tab inside the Add Section picker lets users
  select group headings + children from other templates

Closes #19

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add Section Library UI (Phase 1 of Section Library plan)

Replace the "all sections shown with checkboxes" pattern with an
Add Section picker. Templates now only list sections the user has
explicitly added. New SectionPickerModal groups available sections
by category with search. Data rows get a remove button; the enabled
checkbox is removed since all visible sections are implicitly active.
Duplicate sections are allowed (same section can be added multiple times).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add hierarchical nested section support with depth column

Sections now have an integer depth field (0-3) that implies hierarchy
via ordered sequence — like Markdown headings. Group headings and data
sections at depth>0 visually nest under the nearest shallower heading.

Backend: depth column on template_sections and cv_instance_sections with
migration, schema updates, and depth-aware PDF rendering (per-level
heading styles and optional indentation). Seed templates updated with
Hopkins-style nesting (e.g., Oral Exam Participation under Teaching).

Frontend: indent/outdent buttons on all SectionComposer rows, visual
margin indentation, and sub-heading size / indent-per-level style options.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add backend support for group headings in CV templates

Add rendering, styling, and persistence support for group_heading sections:

- base.html: render group_heading as a styled div before other sections
- pdf.py: add .cv-group-heading CSS class (primary color, bold, border)
- main.py: add group_heading to _HEADINGS; restructure default templates
  to use organized group headings (Education, Publications, Teaching, etc.)
- cv_instances.py: rewrite update_sections as delete-and-recreate to handle
  duplicate group_heading keys, preserving curated item selections

Part of #19.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Extract shared SectionComposer component from Templates and CVInstances

Deduplicate the section composer UI (drag-and-drop sortable list with group
heading support) into a shared component. This is an intermediate step toward
fully addressing #19.

- New SectionComposer.tsx: ALL_SECTIONS, SectionEntry type, buildInitialSections
  helper, and SectionComposer component with render props for consumer-specific
  content (expandable ItemCurator, curated badges)
- Templates.tsx: removed duplicated DnD/section logic, uses SectionComposer
- CVInstances.tsx: same, passes renderExpandedContent/renderBadges
- Updated section consistency tests to read ALL_SECTIONS from shared component

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix YAML import to accept combined backup file from export

The import endpoint now detects when a single file contains top-level
cv/refs keys (the combined format produced by export) and splits it
automatically, so the exported backup can be reimported directly via
the GUI without manually separating files.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Store press outlets as list and complete YAML export/import round-trip (#23)

Press outlets are now stored as a JSON array (data.outlets) instead of a
comma-joined string, with a startup migration for existing data. The YAML
export adds 16+ missing sections and splits grants into activegrants/
completedgrants so export→reimport preserves all data. Includes a full
round-trip test suite.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Wire mentorship section into CV data pipeline

The mentorship section was added to the frontend and template renderer
but was missing from _build_cv_data(), SECTION_KEY_MAP, _CV_DATA_KEY_MAP,
and CVInstances.tsx ALL_SECTIONS — so it always rendered empty.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add admin user management interface

Closes #24

- Add is_admin field to User model with migration
- Add get_current_admin auth dependency (403 for non-admins)
- Add admin router with list/update/delete user endpoints
- Self-protection guards: cannot deactivate/demote/delete yourself
- Delete cascades all user-owned data (works, CV items, templates, etc.)
- Add Users page with status/admin badges, toggle actions, delete confirmation
- Conditionally show Users nav link for admin users only
- 15 backend tests covering all endpoints and edge cases

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix press/media import splitting entries per outlet

Closes #23

Join multiple outlets into a single comma-separated string instead of
creating one DB record per outlet. Show topic as the bold title in both
the section editor and PDF template, with outlets listed below.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add mentorship section and unify trainees into single tab with badges

- Merge Advisees and Postdocs tabs into unified Trainees tab with
  category dropdown and degree/type badges on each entry
- Add new Mentorship section for mentored faculty and other mentees
- Rename Teaching group to Teaching and Mentorship

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Note OpenAlex yearly citation data ~2012 cutoff in source field

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add search capability to CV Sections tab

Searches across all fields (not just title) with case-insensitive
matching. Search clears automatically when switching tabs or groups.
Closes #21.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Restructure dashboard teaching & mentorship with role donuts and mentee categories

Teaching section now shows two side-by-side donut charts by role (overall
and past 5 years). Mentorship is split into degree-level subcategories
(post-doctoral, doctoral, masters, undergraduate, other) with total and
current counts. Fixes is_current detection for trainees with "present"
as their end date.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Restructure dashboard funding stats into active/completed categories

Replace flat grant counters with GrantCategoryStats that groups grants
by status (active/completed), each with its own role breakdown, total
amount, and detailed grant table. Adds id_number to grant details and
shows completed grants panel when present.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Redesign dashboard into tabbed sections with richer stats

Replace flat DashboardStats with DashboardData containing four sub-models
(ScholarlyOutput, TeachingMentorship, Funding, Service). The frontend now
shows a tab bar instead of clickable stat cards. Scholarly Output tab
includes publications-by-year and citations-by-year charts, a donut chart
for work types, and accurate author role counts using profile name matching.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Move citation metrics into Scholarly Works page as a tab

Remove the standalone Citations nav item and route, and instead render
the citation metrics UI as a "Citations" filter tab within the Scholarly
Works page alongside Papers, Preprints, etc.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add citation metrics feature with OpenAlex integration

Adds a Citation Metrics section that can be included in CVs, with
per-work citation data fetched from OpenAlex by DOI. Includes a
dedicated Citations page for viewing/editing aggregate stats (total
citations, h-index, i10-index, yearly counts) and per-work citation
counts. CV rendering uses an inline SVG bar chart with axis labels.
Also adds section key consistency tests across all backend/frontend
registries.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add copy/duplicate button for CV entries and scholarly works

Closes #9 — lets users quickly clone existing entries (e.g. a class
taught across multiple years) by pre-filling the create form with
the copied item's data.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Reset DOI lookup field when opening work modals

Pre-fill with the work's DOI when editing, clear when creating new,
so the field no longer carries over from a previous lookup.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Show informative validation errors on registration form

Parse FastAPI's 422 detail array to display the actual Pydantic
error message (e.g. invalid email) instead of [object Object].

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Render co-first and co-senior author markers in CV publications

Add ‡ superscript for co-first authors and § for co-senior authors,
with corresponding footnotes. Matches existing † (student) and
* (corresponding) pattern.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Default Scholarly Works filter to Papers and move All to end

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Improve Scholarly Works search: inline bar and search all fields

Move search bar inline with Add Work / Find New buttons. Expand keyword
search to match across title, DOI, data fields, and author names.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge pull request #11 from jlessler/works-cvitem-migration

Works cvitem migration

Add standalone migration guide for CVItem/Works restructure

Documents the automatic migration process for users upgrading from the
old per-section table schema, including backup instructions, verification
steps, known edge cases, and rollback procedures.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Rewrite Publications page as Scholarly Works using Works API

- Publications.tsx: complete rewrite to use /api/works endpoints
  - work_type instead of type, fields in data JSON blob
  - Per-author role flags (corresponding, cofirst, cosenior) replace
    pub-level corr/cofirsts/coseniors
  - Conditional form fields by work type (patents, seminars, software,
    dissertation, scientific meetings)
  - All 10 work types filterable (adds patents, seminars, software,
    dissertation to the 6 publication types)
- Dashboard.tsx: update to use /api/works and /api/cv endpoints
  - PubPanel fetches from /works instead of /publications
  - TraineesPanel fetches from /cv/trainees_advisees,trainees_postdocs
  - GrantsPanel fetches from /cv/grants
  - Read fields from CVItem data blobs
- api.ts: replace Publication/PubAuthor with Work/WorkAuthor interfaces
- Layout.tsx: rename sidebar label to "Scholarly Works"

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Update Sections page to use CVItem API endpoints

Frontend Sections.tsx was still calling old per-model endpoints
(/api/education, /api/grants, /api/misc/editorial, etc.) that were
removed in Phase 7. Updated to use unified /api/cv/{section} endpoints:
- All tabs fetch from GET /api/cv/{section}
- Create/update/delete use POST/PUT/DELETE /api/cv
- Field values wrapped/unwrapped from CVItem data JSON blob
- Removed Work-based tabs (patents, seminars, software, dissertation)
  since these are now managed in the Publications page
- Backend cv_items list supports comma-separated sections for editorial

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix migration for real DB: per-user idempotency, schema evolution, authors type handling

- Change migration guards from global to per-user: only migrate users
  who have source data but no works/cv_items yet (fixes user 2 data missing)
- Add ALTER TABLE statements for works, work_authors, cv_items columns
  so existing tables get updated without needing to be dropped
- Handle software MiscSection authors field as list or comma-separated string
- Filter all source queries by uids_to_migrate set

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Expand test suite (+39 tests) and fix crossref DOI mutation bug

Add test_auth.py (10 tests: register, login, me, rate limiting),
test_user_isolation.py (12 tests: cross-user access denied for works,
cv items, templates, profile), test_cv_items_migration.py (10 tests:
idempotency, typed model migration, panel/trainee splitting, instance
item remapping). Extend test_works.py (+7: sync-check, crossref DOI
reciprocal linking on create/update/delete). Extend test_export.py
(+3: YAML import POST with cv_file and refs_file).

Fix SQLAlchemy JSON mutation detection bug in _sync_crossref_links and
delete_work: copy data dict before modifying (dict(...) instead of
reference) so attribute reassignment is detected as a change.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Phase 7: Remove old per-section CRUD endpoints, schemas, and sort keys

Strip profile.py down to Profile/Address only (removed 13 section CRUD
groups + factory functions + misc section endpoints). Remove ~40 typed
schema classes from schemas.py. Remove 13 old model sort keys from
sort.py, keeping only Work and CVItem. Old ORM model classes retained
in models.py for migration function compatibility.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Phase 6: Migrate typed models to CVItem, switch rendering and import/export

Add _migrate_cv_items_data() for one-time migration of Education, Experience,
Consulting, Membership, Panel, Symposium, Class, Grant, Award, Press, Trainee,
Committee, and MiscSection rows into unified cv_items table. Update
_build_cv_data() to query CVItem, SECTION_KEY_MAP to use CVItem, yaml_import
to create CVItems, export to read from CVItems, and dashboard to aggregate
from CVItems. Templates need zero changes thanks to CVItem.__getattr__.
All 254 tests pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Phase 5: Add CVItem model, schemas, sort helpers, and CRUD router

Create CVItem model with __getattr__ delegation to JSON data blob.
Add CVItemBase/Create/Update/Out schemas, compute_sort_date() helper
with SORT_DATE_FIELD_MAP for date extraction, and generic CRUD router
at /api/cv/{section}. 12 new tests, 254 total passing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Phase 4: Remove old Publication, Patent, Seminar routers, schemas, and tests

Delete publications router and unregister from main. Remove patent/seminar
CRUD from profile router. Remove Publication/PubAuthor/Patent/Seminar schemas
and sort keys. Update fetch_pubs.py to query Work model with proper year/type
handling. Fix test helper to use /api/works endpoint. 242 tests pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Switch rendering, import/export, and dashboard to Work model (Phase 3)

- _build_cv_data() queries Work for publications, patents, seminars,
  software, and dissertation instead of old typed models
- cv_instances SECTION_KEY_MAP updated to use Work model
- publications.html uses work_type, per-author corresponding flags
- base.html patents/seminars/software/dissertation use Work attributes
  via __getattr__ delegation to data JSON
- yaml_import creates Work+WorkAuthor for publications, patents,
  seminars, software, dissertation
- export.py queries Work, reconstructs corr/cofirsts/coseniors from
  per-author flags for YAML compatibility
- Dashboard queries Work for publication counts
- Integration tests updated to use /api/works endpoints

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add works data migration from publications, patents, seminars, software, dissertation (Phase 2)

Idempotent _migrate_works_data() copies all source rows into works table:
- Publications → Work + WorkAuthor with corr/cofirsts/coseniors converted to per-author flags
- Patents → Work + WorkAuthor
- Seminars → Work with date parsed to year/month
- Software MiscSection → Work + WorkAuthor (comma-sep authors parsed)
- Dissertation MiscSection → Work
- CVInstanceItem IDs remapped to new Work IDs
Non-numeric years (e.g. "in press") preserved in data.year_raw. 12 new tests.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add Work + WorkAuthor models and /api/works endpoints (Phase 1)

Introduces unified Work model (hybrid promoted columns + JSON data) and
WorkAuthor with per-author role flags (corresponding, cofirst, cosenior).
New /api/works router with full CRUD, DOI lookup, sync-check/add, and
crossref link sync. Coexists with existing Publication/Patent/Seminar
models — no breaking changes. 21 new tests (251 total passing).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add per-section cross-ref DOI display options for templates and CV instances

Adds show_crossref and hide_if_published config options to publication
sections (papers and preprints), controllable via expandable panels in
both the template composer and CV instance editor. CV instances merge
template section config as a base with instance-level overrides on top.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add reciprocal cross-reference DOI linking on create, update, and delete

When a publication's preprint_doi or published_doi is set, the counterpart
publication (matched by DOI within the same user) automatically gets the
reverse link. Changing or clearing a cross-ref also updates the old
counterpart. Deleting a publication clears any reciprocal link on its pair.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Broaden Crossref enrichment to fill journal and other missing metadata

ORCID results often only have title/year/DOI. The enrichment step already
fetched the full Crossref record but only copied authors. Now it also fills
journal, volume, issue, pages, and year when missing. Pub type is re-inferred
after enrichment so preprints from bioRxiv/medRxiv are correctly classified.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add preprint↔published cross-reference DOIs with auto-population in Find New flow

Adds preprint_doi/published_doi columns to the Publication model and wires them
through the full stack: schema, YAML import/export, template rendering, and the
publication edit form. During "Find New" dedup, when a candidate fuzzy-matches an
existing publication of the opposite type (preprint vs published), the cross-ref
DOI is auto-populated on the candidate and reciprocally on the existing DB record.
The candidate UI shows the detected cross-link at a glance and allows editing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Remove template PDF and HTML preview exports from Import/Export page

PDF and HTML preview export should only be available for CV instances,
not templates directly. Keep YAML backup and CV instance PDF export.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Replace theme selector with per-template style properties

Replace monolithic CSS theme files with a `style` JSON column on templates
that stores individual styling properties (colors, fonts, sizes, decorations).
CSS is now generated dynamically via `generate_css()` from style dicts.

- Add `style` JSON column to CVTemplate and `style_overrides` to CVInstance
- Add `generate_css()` and `THEME_PRESETS` dict in services/pdf.py
- Delete 6 static theme CSS files (academic, unc, hopkins, unige, minimal, modern)
- Add style editor UI with basic/advanced sections in Templates page
- Add "Copy style from" workflow when creating new templates
- Add StyleOverrideEditor to CV instances page
- Add CV instances router with CRUD, curation, preview, and PDF export
- Add migration to backfill style from old theme_css and drop legacy columns
- Add error handling and loading states to PDF export buttons
- Add test_generate_css.py (47 tests) and test_cv_instances.py (44 tests)
- Update existing tests and CLAUDE.md for new architecture

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Rename Export tab to Import/Export

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge pull request #8 from jlessler/multiuser

Add JWT-based multi-user authentication. 

Tested and all seems good and the single user functionality still works OK. This is better for testing so I think it is good to make the main mode of operation even if we never really have a mulit-user installation.

Add JWT-based multi-user authentication

- Add User model with email/password, user_id FK on all 18 content tables
- Add auth.py (JWT create/verify, bcrypt hashing, get_current_user dependency)
- Add auth router (register, login, me endpoints) with rate limiting
- Scope all ~40 API endpoints to authenticated user via user_id filtering
- Fix YAML import to only delete/replace current user's data (safety-critical)
- Add frontend auth flow: AuthContext, Login/Register pages, ProtectedRoute
- Add Axios interceptors for Bearer token and 401 redirect
- Add user email display and logout button to sidebar
- Support token query parameter on preview endpoint for iframe/link auth
- Update test fixtures to use authenticated test user
- Update cvbuilder/README.md with auth docs and Einstein sample tutorial
- Default account: admin@local / changeme (created on first startup)

Flag fuzzy-matched publications as possible duplicates in Find New modal

Instead of only dropping exact matches (DOI / normalized title+year),
also detect near-duplicates using title similarity (max of Jaccard and
overlap coefficient on normalized word sets, threshold 0.75, ±2-year
tolerance for preprint→published transitions).

Fuzzy-matched candidates are kept in the results but marked with a
match_warning string pointing to the existing similar paper. In the
UI they show an amber "Possible duplicate" badge + warning text, and
are auto-deselected so the user must consciously choose to import them.
